diff --git a/src/evidence_harness/prompting.py b/src/evidence_harness/prompting.py
index 1267cc2..b04bb15 100644
--- a/src/evidence_harness/prompting.py
+++ b/src/evidence_harness/prompting.py
@@ -56,6 +56,13 @@ Rules:
   for completion. Submit focused checks or stop; do not propose more exploration.
 - true, echo, printf, pwd, directory listings, and display-only reads are not completion checks.
 - Use replan when the current approach is wrong. Use stop only when blocked, unsafe, or impossible.
+- Do not stop or give up because a first approach failed. Before using stop, try at least two
+  materially different approaches (other tools, flags, versions, or workarounds) and read error
+  messages carefully. Missing tools can often be installed or built from available sources.
+- Before finish, re-read the ORIGINAL TASK and list every concrete requirement: exact file paths,
+  names, ports, output formats, and CLI behavior. Completion checks must exercise those exact
+  details the way an independent grader would, from a fresh process, and run any test suite or
+  example commands the task or project provides. Passing a check you wrote is not enough.
 - Keep rationale short. State the current fact and why the selected action changes or proves it.
 """.strip()
